summary: Frontend-only Playwright verification of redesigned Stock Dashboard tab (/app/frontend/app/(tabs)/stocks.tsx). All required sections render with correct mock data and every tap target navigates to a real (matched) route. Category bars animate and render proportionally (Electronics 164px > Apparel 107px > Grocery 82px > Hardware 57px, matching 520K:340K:260K:180K).

react_native_issues.component: stocks/settings screen (out of scope for this task)
react_native_issues.issue: Console error observed when navigating to /stocks/settings: 'Unexpected text node: A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.' — indicates a raw whitespace/string is rendered directly inside a <View>. Not on the (tabs)/stocks.tsx file that was rewritten, but discovered while validating header icon nav. Reference: /app/frontend/app/stocks/settings.tsx

action_items: Optional: Investigate and clean up the 'Unexpected text node' RN warning emitted by /app/frontend/app/stocks/settings.tsx (whitespace/string directly under a <View>). Not caused by the current stocks.tsx rewrite.
critical_code_review_comments: stocks.tsx uses `route as any` casts on router.push — fine because Expo Router treats them as valid Href strings; all 11 target routes exist under /app/frontend/app/stocks/.

CategoryBar correctly uses useNativeDriver:false for width animation (native driver cannot animate layout). SegmentedBar has a web guard that sets filled=SEG_COUNT immediately on web — works and avoids setTimeout jank on the web preview.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (11/11 tap targets navigate to correct route, 24/24 content checks OK)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth bypass: localStorage.setItem('auth_token','mock_token_123') via page.add_init_script BEFORE page.goto, then Skip the onboarding carousel. Reach the Stock dashboard by tapping the bottom-tab 'Stocks'. Header action icons have no testID — locate them via bounding-box scan (top<80, borderWidth>0, ~36x36 boxes) and click via page.mouse.click(cx,cy). Verified navigation targets: hero->/stocks/total-stock, Warehouses tile & Utilisation card->/stocks/warehouses, Low-Stock tile & Reorder strip->/stocks/reorder-queue, Fast-Moving->/stocks/movement-analytics, Aged->/stocks/aged-items, Report link->/stocks/valuation-summary, header icons->/stocks/reports,/stocks/settings,/stocks/barcodes.
rca_of_issue: No functional issue in stocks.tsx. Only a benign RN console warning ('Unexpected text node') was seen on the /stocks/settings child screen — root cause is a stray whitespace/string rendered as direct child of a <View> in that separate file, unrelated to the current rewrite.
